versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-ecs-diagnose v0.0.5

- Updated installation guidance: now prioritizes using the signed CLI package with verifiable steps, remote script allowed only as fallback.
- Enforces that Alibaba Cloud credentials and region configuration are verified before any plugin setup commands.
- Clarified CLI region/endpoint flag usage and parameter handling especially for different plugin versions (ecs/vpc/ebs/cms).
- Expanded and clarified CLI parameter standards: removed obsolete formats and detailed command-specific variations.
- Improved security and error-handling instructions for all credential and permission-related steps.
- Removed skill-card.md.

**Added support for ECS EBS disk performance diagnostics via EBS APIs and CLI plugin.**

- New disk performance diagnosis scenario, including abnormal disk IO/IOPS/latency cases.
- Updated triggers and description for disk IO and performance issues.
- Added EBS diagnosis API requirements and plugin pre-checks.
- Introduced new required RAM permissions for EBS APIs.
- User-Agent standard now includes skill version (from manifest).
- Reference docs and scripts added for EBS diagnosis workflow.

alibabacloud-ecs-diagnose v0.0.3

- Added mandatory full-session observability: every `aliyun` CLI command invoking a cloud API now requires a globally generated 32-character session ID appended to the User-Agent string.
- Moved the AI-mode enable/disable workflow out; now relies entirely on standard CLI session and User-Agent tracking.
- Introduced an explicit "Phase 0: Instance Discovery" as a required step before any scenario-based diagnostics, with strict handling of empty instance search results.
- Updated CLI command requirements to use `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-ecs-diagnose/{session-id}` for all cloud API calls; local utility commands are excluded.
- Improved security notes, usage safeguards, and clarified parameter/user confirmation and permission error workflows.
- Removed obsolete documentation files and redundant enable/disable AI-mode steps.

alibabacloud-ecs-diagnose 0.0.2

- Now requires Aliyun CLI >= 3.3.3 (was 3.3.1); improved CLI installation and upgrade guidance.
- Enforces Aliyun CLI plugin update and `--auto-plugin-install true` configuration before diagnostics.
- Introduces mandatory "AI-mode" enable/disable requirements: must enable at workflow start and disable AI-mode on all exit paths.
- Requires every CLI invocation to include `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-ecs-diagnose`.
- Documentation and command usage instructions updated for clarity, compliance, and consistent user-agent.

Initial release: Systematic ECS instance diagnostics for Alibaba Cloud.

- Provides a two-level diagnostic workflow (Basic + Deep) for ECS operational issues.
- Covers scenarios like server connectivity failure, SSH timeout, instance lag, disk full, high CPU/memory, status anomalies, and system events.
- Requires explicit user confirmation for all customizable parameters.
- Integrates cloud platform and GuestOS diagnostics via Cloud Assistant.
- Enforces strict credential and permission handling for secure operations.
- Outputs a structured diagnostic report with issue summary and recommendations.
